paper_title: Anisotropic cosmic optical background bound for decaying dark matter in light of the LORRI anomaly
coupling_convention: g_χγγ in GeV^-1 (approximate from Figure 3 exclusion bounds)
notes: Paper derives exclusion limits on decaying dark matter (ALP) from cosmic optical background (COB) anisotropy measurements by HST. The primary result is Figure 3, which translates constraints on decay rate Γ̂ into ALP-photon coupling g_χγγ for the mass range 5–25 eV. The bounds exclude decay rates larger than 10^−24–10^−23 s^−1 in the 5–20 eV mass range. Data points are approximate readings from Figure 3's exclusion boundary. The paper uses Eq. (3): Γ = g²_χγγ m³_χ / (64π) to convert between decay rate and coupling. Confidence is moderate (0.65) because: (1) exact numerical values are read from a figure rather than a table, (2) the paper's primary focus is on decay rate Γ̂ rather than coupling g_χγγ, and (3) the conversion involves model assumptions (R=1, q_γ=2 for ALP). The 95% CL is stated in the text. This is a cosmological/astrophysical bound, not a haloscope experiment, so dm_density_assumed is null. | selector: text (sole candidate)
